Marta — thanks for sending this over and for the packet. We're happy to walk through the procurement path. Quick summary so your finance/procurement can expect a single source of truth:

1) Identity & tax proof: For US entities we ask for W-9 + legal entity name and EIN. For non-US/EU entities we require a VAT certificate or local tax registration doc. Because you operate across regions, we'll need both (W-9 for the US parent + VAT proof for your EU subsidiary) before invoicing on our end. (If you'd prefer redaction, we accept notarized or portal-validated copies.)

2) Marketplace billing vs Redwood invoicing:
   - AWS Marketplace: can go through AWS meter/billing (marketplace purchase) or through vendor-managed invoicing. If you want Redwood to invoice Helios directly (so Helios receives a Redwood PO/invoice) we require a vendor setup on our finance ledger and a purchase order from Helios tied to the HubSpot deal.
   - GCP Marketplace: typically vendor-managed invoicing; we can offer both routes but the PO path is slower (requires our FinOps setup).

3) Bank wiring & tax withholding: Redwood prefers ACH/wire for managed vendor invoicing. For marketplace-driven purchases processed by the cloud provider (AWS/GCP), provider payout rules apply.

Next steps I recommend:
- Ben (cc'd) will run a quick vendor intake for Helios and flag whether the AWS path can be marketplace-billed or needs vendor-invoice mode.
- Vanessa (cc'd) will confirm if Redwood needs a custom PO template or if standard Helios PO is sufficient.
- I'll upload our onboarding packet and list all required evidence items you submitted.

I'll attach the onboarding packet in my next internal note and set a short timeline (3–5 business days) for vendor validation once we have the signed PO and the tax docs.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Alliances Manager | Redwood Inference
[redwood.ai]

Hi team — looping in FinOps details here.

Irene: thanks for the clear framing. For Helios specifically, our standard vendor intake checklist will need the following before we can create Helios as a vendor in our AP system and accept PO-based payments:

- Signed vendor W-9 or W-8 (depending on entity) — electronic copy acceptable.
- Bank account verification (ACH test deposit or completed bank details form).
- Signed commercial terms (SOW or Master Vendor Agreement) + purchase order referencing HL-2027-0421.
- Contact info for remittance and tax invoicing (email + AP contact).

Marketplace considerations:
- If Helios elects marketplace billing through AWS, Redwood will not issue invoices for marketplace-metered purchases; revenue flows through AWS and payout to you is governed by AWS terms.
- If you want Helios to pay Redwood directly (so Redwood raises invoices and Helios issues POs to Redwood), we need the vendor record to be created and the PO on file before the first paid invoiced period. That process takes ~4 business days once we receive completed paperwork.

Iris (Kimberly), please confirm if there are any additional KYC checks for Helios's EU entity.

Ben Carter
FinOps Manager | Redwood Inference
